snippet.title: Nimillion - The last expedition - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Space lander adventure with MetroidVania progression system. Retro-inspired Thruster-only flight, upgrade abilities, battle tough bosses, conquer brutal terrain. Easy to learn, hard to master old-school thrills! Highly replayable with over 15 hours of gameplay for the main story, speed runs with leaderboard and difficulty levels that change the way you play! Play in both small and huge levels.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2889880/Nimillion__The_last_expedition/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
